title: Risk of Bias Plots for Meta-Analyses in R
text: Traffic-Light Plots: Domain-level judgements study, displayed icons clean table Weighted Summary Plots: Stacked bar plots proportion studies (meta-analytic weight) judgement Multiple Tools: RoB 2 (including cluster-randomised crossover variants), ROBINS-V2, ROBINS-E, QUADAS-2, CLARITY, RoB NMA, PROBAST PROBAST+AI Automatic Overall Judgements: Overall risk bias derived domains supplied Flexible Input: Judgements “low”, “Low risk” “low risk bias” standardised automatically Subgroup Analysis: Group studies outcome, design analysis Tool-Specific Legends: Legends list domains judgements present plot Extensive Customisation: Fonts, titles, sorting layout

what: RoB 2 judgements from signalling questions — rob2_algorithm
title: RoB 2 judgements from signalling questions — rob2_algorithm
text: Applies RoB 2 algorithms answers signalling questions returns domain overall risk bias judgements, ready rob_plot() rob_summary(). Supports individually randomised parallel-group, cluster-randomised crossover trials (RoB 2 cribsheets, 2019 2021), can mixed within one meta-analysis.

title: RoB 2 judgements from signalling questions — rob2_algorithm
code: rob2_algorithm(   data,   design = "parallel",   effect = c("assignment", "adhering"),   keep_answers = FALSE )

title: RoB 2 judgements from signalling questions — rob2_algorithm
text: data data frame one row per study one column per signalling question, named RoB 2 cribsheets: Domain 1: 1.1-1.3 (1a.1-1a.3). Domain 1b (cluster trials): 1b.1-1b.3. Domain S (crossover trials): S.1-S.3. Domain 2: 2.1-2.7 (cluster trials, effect assignment: 2.1a 2.1b place 2.1). Domain 3: 3.1-3.4 (cluster trials: 3.1a 3.1b). Domain 4: 4.1-4.5 (cluster trials: 4.3a 4.3b). Domain 5: 5.1-5.3 (crossover trials: also 5.4). Prefixes underscores allowed (e.g. q1_1, D2.1a). Answers Y, PY, PN, N NI, abbreviated full (e.g. "Probably yes"). Leave questions algorithm skips empty; required question left empty treated "information". design Trial design: "parallel" (default), "cluster" "crossover". Either one value studies, unquoted column name giving design study. effect Effect interest domain 2: "assignment" (intention--treat effect, default) "adhering" (per-protocol effect). keep_answers Logical. Keep signalling question columns? (default: FALSE).

title: RoB 2 judgements from signalling questions — rob2_algorithm
text: data columns D1, (D1b), D2-D5, (DS) Overall.

title: RoB 2 judgements from signalling questions — rob2_algorithm
text: Domain judgements follow cribsheet algorithms. overall judgement "Low" domains low risk, "High" domain high risk, "concerns" otherwise. guidance allows "concerns" multiple domains judged high overall; edit Overall make call. D1b returned cluster trials, DS crossover trials. NA studies designs.

title: Create Risk of Bias Plot — rob_plot
text: data data frame study, year domain columns chosen rob_tool (see Details). Judgements standardised (e.g. "low risk" -> "Low"); NA -> "applicable". Judgements recognised tool shown blank cells, warning. studyvar, year <data-masking> Study label year columns. group <data-masking> Subgroup column, used subgroup = TRUE. effect <data-masking> Effect size column, used sorting "effect". rob_tool Risk bias tool: "rob2" (default), "robins_i", "robins_e", "quadas2", "clarity", "rob_nma", "probast", "probast_ai". sort_studies_by sort studies: "author" (default), "year", "effect". subgroup Logical. Create subgroup plot? (default: FALSE). sort_subgroup_by Subgroup ordering: "alphabetical" (default), "effect", character vector subgroup names desired order. show_overall Logical. Show overall column(s)? (default: TRUE). Overall columns absent data derived domains (worst judgement). derive_overall Logical. Always re-derive overall column(s) domains, overwriting supplied values? (default: FALSE). add_rob_legend Logical. Add legend? (default: FALSE). study_label Header study column. Defaults "Trial" randomised trial tools ("rob2", "clarity"), "Review" "rob_nma", "Study" otherwise. font Font family. title, subtitle Plot title subtitle. title_align Title alignment: "left" (default), "center"/"centre", "right".
